entities.summary: Peju Layiwola (b. 1967-09-29, Benin City) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Benin City and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, painters & sculptors, africa.
